correctedState:
apiKeyHelper is shipped and reachable on the surface this page governs; what is actually true is a much narrower precedence point, and it is Claude's own documented precedence rather than a missing mechanism.

SHIPPED: the native Claude Agent SDK binary implements apiKeyHelper and CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS (46 and 7 occurrences respectively in node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude; 1 and 0 in the JS core), and it is staged into the packaged app by scripts/build/common.ts:337-376 and the three platform build scripts, under the NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE flag that also gates the Claude provider itself. First-party code opens rather than closes the seam: claude-agent.ts:305 passes settingSources ['user','project','local'] explicitly so a settings-file apiKeyHelper is loaded (user scope resolving under the per-Workspace CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set at options.ts:250-255); options.ts:236-263 forwards the whole host env minus three Bedrock keys, so the TTL override reaches the consumer; claude-settings-store.ts:118-164 merge-preserves unknown settings keys.

THE RESIDUAL, stated precisely: resolveAuthEnvVars (packages/shared/src/config/llm-connections.ts:1035-1051) injects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unconditionally for every `anthropic` connection whose authType is 'api_key' - including the literal string 'not-needed' when the connection is keyless but has a baseUrl. authentication.md:170-171 ranks ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 3rd and apiKeyHelper 4th, so on exactly the gateway shape this page describes (anthropic provider + custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + api_key auth) a configured helper is SHADOWED by our injection. On authType 'oauth' the injected CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is rank 5 and the helper outranks it, so vault-backed rotation does have a supported path; and a host-shell ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (rank 2) survives buildClaudeSubprocessEnv un-clobbered and outranks our injection, so bearer-token gateways work today. If a row is wanted, it should be 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY injection shadows a user-configured apiKeyHelper on anthropic api_key connections' - a precedence defect with a one-line fix (skip the injection when the resolved key is absent/'not-needed'), not 'no apiKeyHelper support'.

Also correct the framing: the dp/Nestor path and 'custom endpoint' (pi_compat / codex-runtime, api_key_with_endpoint) are the Pi and Codex backends, the fork's deliberate corporate-gateway product difference, and are outside this page's scope. Within that path, packages/shared/src/auth/dp/dp-api.ts:39 execFiles `dp auth print-token` with expiry-aware caching (creds-store.ts:64) and a spawn-collapsing session broker - a command-based rotating-credential mint that is hard-wired rather than absent.
